bib.title: REALTOXICITYPROMPTS: Evaluating Neural Toxic Degeneration in Language Models
bib.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2020

read.skipped: The PDF ends with references; the appendices (A-E) cited in the text are not included, so hyperparameters for detox methods are not available.

question: To what extent can pretrained LMs be prompted into toxic generations, how well do controllable generation methods prevent it, and where does the toxicity in pretraining data come from?
hypothesis: Models acquire toxicity from pretraining data, so steering after pretraining and better data selection are needed.
contributions: RealToxicityPrompts, 100K naturally occurring prompts with Perspective toxicity scores
Evaluation of five LMs and six detoxification methods
First large-scale toxicity analysis of OpenAI-WT and OWTC, incl. provenance (unreliable news, banned subreddits)

method.summary: Sentence-level prompts sampled from OWTC stratified by Perspective toxicity are split into prompt and continuation. Five LMs generate continuations, scored by Perspective API. Six detoxification methods on GPT-2 are compared, and two web corpora are scored.
method.task: toxic degeneration evaluation under prompted generation

datasets.name: RealToxicityPrompts
datasets.split: 25K sentences from each of four toxicity ranges [0,.25)...[.75,1], each split in half
datasets.source: OpenWebText Corpus sentences, scored by Perspective API; released at toxicdegeneration.allenai.org
datasets.preprocessing: Appendix A not in the PDF

datasets.name: OWTC
datasets.split: ~150K docs used for detox further pretraining, disjoint from prompts
datasets.source: Reddit outbound links, karma>=3, English, >128 tokens

datasets.name: OpenAI-WT
datasets.source: GPT-2 training corpus; about 29% overlap with OWTC (>=2.3M docs)

models.name: GPT-2-small
models.params: inferred: similar to GPT-1 (117M) from 'similarly sized'

other.also: GPT-2 base for all detox methods

inference.samples: 25 generations per prompt (10 per prompt for PPLM on 10K prompts); unprompted: pool of 10K spans, bootstrap 1K resamples per n
inference.prompting: prompt is sentence prefix; unprompted uses start token (<|endoftext|> for GPT-2/3, 'Links'/'Wiki' for CTRL, '. ' for GPT-1); ATCON prepends <|nontoxic|>

parameters.word_filter: LDNOOBW list probability set to zero
parameters.DAPT: continued pretraining on ~150K OWTC docs, non-toxic subset (and toxic as reference)

metrics.name: Expected maximum toxicity
metrics.definition: mean and std of max Perspective TOXICITY over k=25 generations per prompt

metrics.name: Toxicity probability
metrics.definition: empirical probability of at least one generation with TOXICITY>=0.5 over 25 generations

eval.protocol: Perspective API TOXICITY (CNN, AUC 0.97, isotonic calibrated); toxic if >=0.5; small manual check on 100 docs and 100 generations; no seeds or significance tests stated for generation

limits: Perspective API is imperfect, biased against minority identity mentions and African American English, lexical-cue driven (Limitations, 2.2)
Only five LMs studied, no masked LMs
Web-corpus toxicity numbers are lower bounds because OpenAI-WT lacks metadata

Appendices not in the supplied PDF
Dated: GPT-3 davinci, GPT-2-small era models; no instruction-tuned models
